items.raw_excerpt: The environmental cost of a new pair of jeans could be enough to make a shopper blue.
items.summary_en: Research shows that making a new pair of jeans has 180 times the environmental impact of buying a second-hand pair. Scientists measured water use, carbon emissions, and pollution across the whole process. The study hopes shoppers will think twice before buying brand new denim.

items.title_en: New jeans cost 180 times more to the environment than second-hand pair
